items.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
items.summary: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

items.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
items.summary: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

items.title: 'The city is alive': A brief peace in Kherson, but residents fear what comes next
items.summary: A temporary ceasefire has brought rare quiet to Kherson, offering its residents a glimpse of normal life before fighting resumes.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
items.summary: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
items.summary: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

items.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
items.summary: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.
